Background Matrix.Type: uniform, granular, light-toned substrate with a fine, slightly textured surface
Background Matrix.Color: pale gray to off-white, with a consistent, muted tone across the entire field
Background Matrix.Size: covers the entire visible area, with no defined boundaries or dimensions, appearing as a continuous field
Background Matrix.Material: solid, non-reflective, possibly mineral or synthetic composite material
Background Matrix.Composition: composed of a fine, homogenous base material with embedded particulates
Background Matrix.Quantity: single continuous layer, filling the entire visual field without gaps or interruptions
Background Matrix.Relative Location: occupies the entire frame, serving as the foundational substrate for all other features

Speckles.Material: dense, opaque particulate material, possibly mineral or synthetic in origin
Speckles.Composition: composed of dense, dark-colored mineral or pigment particles, likely embedded within or resting on the matrix surface, with no visible internal structure
Speckles.Quantity: numerous, densely distributed across the entire matrix; estimated in the hundreds to thousands
Speckles.Relative Location: scattered throughout the background matrix, with no preferred region or clustering pattern

Speckles.Connection or Attachments: embedded within or adhered to the surface of the background matrix, with no visible connections to each other or to external structures
